explanation: Hollis Mbeki kept Tansleigh Packaging at the start of 2025 (D054), but the 2025-05-19 note says Tobias Rendle owns it from that date (D085). The July visit note, written by someone newly managing the account, fits that handoff (D087). The 2025-09-08 weekly refers to the account Tobias runs (D105), with no later reassignment recorded.
